title.rendered: Exploring UAE Visit Visa Types: Find the Perfect One for Your Trip!

content.rendered:
The UAE could be a dream destination for millions, advertising cutting edge skylines, brilliant deserts, and a wealthy social heritage. Whether you’re going to for relaxation, business, or to rejoin with family, securing the correct UAE visit visa is the primary step in planning your trip. But with numerous visa alternatives accessible, how do you know which one is right for you?

In this blog, we’ll explore the different UAE visit visa types, their benefits, and how Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism can assist you in getting your visa rapidly and hassle-free. 

Why Visit the UAE?

Before diving into the types of visas, first, let’s see why the UAE is such an appreciative destination.

  • Unparalleled Luxury – One of the iconic landmarks situated in UAE like Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, and the most luxurious hotels and malls.
  • Cultural Wonders – It is rich in culture, whether you enjoy a desert safari or want to visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
  • Business & Opportunities – People from all over the world travel here. It is a global business hub for all entrepreneurs and professionals.
  • Shopping & Entertainment – It caters to all kinds of travelers like malls, amusement parks, hotels etc.

Types of UAE Visit Visas & Who They’re For

Visa type depends on the purpose of your visit, here are some key options that you can opt for:

  • UAE Tourist Visa – Perfect for Vacationers

If you are planning a short holiday trip, it is the best option for you.

  • Duration: Usually its duration is 30 to 90 days.
  • Entry: You can choose between a single or multi-entry visa option.
  • Extension: It can be extended while being in the UAE.

It is the best option for vacation or family visits.

  • Five-Year Multiple Entry Visa – Ideal for Frequent Travelers

If you are a frequent traveler and do not to reapply for a visa. This can be a game-changer for you.

  • Validity: Usually expires in 5 years from the issue date.
  • Stay Duration: One visit lasts 90 days and can be extended for another 90 days.
  • Eligibility: People from all nationalities can apply.

It is best for people with businesses and those who have families.

  • Job Seeker Visa – For Career Opportunities

People who are interested in working in UAE. This visa allows one to explore job opportunities without any sponsor.

  • Duration: It lasts for 60 to 90 days.
  • Entry: It is a single entry visa.
  • Purpose: You can explore job opportunities and attend interviews.

It is best for people who have an interest in seeking a job in UAE.

  • Transit Visa – For Short Stopovers

If you want to explore the UAE while going to another destination. A transit visa can allow you to have a layover.

  • Duration: It is available for 48 to 96 hours.
  • Entry: It is a single entry visa.
  • Requirement: You must have another flight.

It is best for people who have another main destination and want to enjoy the UAE for a shorter experience.

  • Patient and Companion Entry Permit – For Medical Visits

If you have any medical treatment to take, this visa allows you to enter for medical purposes.

  • Validity: It depends on the medical treatment plan.
  • Entry: It can be single or multiple entry,
  • Requirement: It must be sponsored by a licensed medical facility.

It is best for people seeking medical care in the UAE for the best treatment.

Final Thoughts: Ready to Visit the UAE?
